trust_decision.summary: Whether caller-supplied sender values (guest 'fromname', from/from_named, return_email, request host) may contain CR/LF before being emitted as mail headers / SMTP lines; at pinned commit only to/subject are stripped by MailHandler::cleanup, while from, from_named, return_email and the Message-ID host are emitted raw, and member.php puts the unvalidated guest fromname into the From value.

landing_point.why: Advisory title is 'Email User CRLF injection'; do_emailuser builds the From string from guest-supplied fromname, which is only checked for non-empty (member.php:2938) while fromemail gets validate_email_format (member.php:2933).

fix_sites.entry_point: POST member.php?action=do_emailuser (guest or member Email User form)
MailHandler::build_message via my_mail() $from (inc/functions.php:679); used by every mail sender
fix_sites.module_kind: lower-level mail library base class (shared by PhpMail and SmtpMail)

fix_sites.entry_point: MailHandler::build_message via my_mail() $return_email; reached by sendthread.php:206, contact.php:226 and (post-fix) member.php emailuser
MailHandler::set_common_headers Message-ID host from $_SERVER SERVER_NAME/HTTP_HOST, on every my_mail call
fix_sites.module_kind: lower-level mail library base class (environment-derived header)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: inc/class_mailhandler.php:158-177 and inc/class_mailhandler.php:338 (MailHandler::build_message / set_common_headers; feeds From/Return-Path/Reply-To/Message-ID at inc/class_mailhandler.php:317-342 and SMTP MAIL FROM at inc/mailhandlers/smtp.php:207)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once the guest fromname is validated/removed in member.php the report's example is closed, and every other caller of my_mail validates its addresses with validate_email_format (sendthread.php:163, contact.php:152), so hardening the shared MailHandler and the server-supplied Message-ID host looks like unneeded defence-in-depth.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-ASCII subjects and board names are RFC2047-encoded into multiple encoded-words joined by '\n' (header folding), and message bodies are deliberately normalised to CRLF; an over-broad fix that strips/rejects all CR/LF in assembled headers or the message, or rejects non-ASCII names, breaks multi-chunk UTF-8 subjects/From names and multi-line bodies. Also members' real display name/email must still send.

O6_input_shapes: guest fromname containing CR, LF or CRLF (member.php:2976)
from argument to my_mail/build_message with CR/LF (inc/class_mailhandler.php:160-161)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SMTP HELO/EHLO line built from $_SERVER['SERVER_NAME'] without CR/LF stripping, same host value the fix cleans for Message-ID
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only a third fallback after gethostname()/php_uname, it is an SMTP command not a mail header, and it is server-provided rather than user input
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: inc/mailhandlers/smtp.php, separate transport subclass from member.php landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Send-to-friend could put guest fromname into a From display-name like member.php:2976 did
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same form fields (fromname/fromemail) and same validation pattern as Email User (sendthread.php:157-171); a maintainer could naturally mirror the 'Name <email>' From construction.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Contact form could pass a guest-supplied name as the From display name or into a custom header via my_mail's $headers argument
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: my_mail exposes $headers (inc/functions.php:634) which build_message stores raw (inc/class_mailhandler.php:156), and the contact page already forwards user email as Reply-To.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: set_charset value interpolated into Content-Type headers (inc/class_mailhandler.php:265) without cleanup
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: charset is a caller-supplied my_mail argument; a plugin or feature passing a user/language-selected charset is plausible.

O9_family: CWE-93 CRLF injection into mail headers / SMTP command lines
